SELECT
    count(*) AS "MYO",
    (SELECT count(*)
     FROM delivery_export."delivery_box" db 
     JOIN delivery_export.sales_orders_map som 
     ON db.id = som.delivery_box::uuid 
     WHERE db.shipment_date = {{shipment_date.formattedDate}} 
     AND som.archived != true
		 AND som.make_your_own = 'false') AS "CURATED",
     (SELECT count(*)
     FROM delivery_export."delivery_box" db 
     LEFT JOIN delivery_export.sales_orders_map som 
     ON db.id = som.delivery_box::uuid 
     WHERE db.shipment_date = {{shipment_date.formattedDate}}
     AND (som.make_your_own = 'false')
		 AND som.archived != true
		 AND db.box_code != 'BLANK_BOX') as "ASSIGNED",
		  ( SELECT count(*)
     FROM delivery_export."delivery_box" db 
     LEFT JOIN delivery_export.sales_orders_map som 
     ON db.id = som.delivery_box::uuid 
     WHERE db.shipment_date = {{shipment_date.formattedDate}}
     AND (som.make_your_own = 'false') 
		 AND db.box_code = 'BLANK_BOX'
		 AND som.archived != true) AS "UNASSIGNED"
FROM
    delivery_export."delivery_box" db 
JOIN 
    delivery_export.sales_orders_map som 
ON 
    db.id = som.delivery_box::uuid 
WHERE 
    db.shipment_date = {{shipment_date.formattedDate}} 
    AND som.make_your_own = 'true'
		AND som.archived != true
		
;
